가장 먼저 끝나는 곳은 롬앤의 핑크오피스(@romand_pinkoffice)인데요, 브랜드 10주년을 맞아 생일파티로 꾸민 공간이 11월 10일까지 열립니다. 연무장5길의 짱구 체험전은 관람객이 떡잎마을을 돌며 전용 앱과 QR로 신형만·봉미선·신짱아를 찾아 모으는 방식이고, 내년 1월까지 이어집니다.

Three pop-ups in Seongsu-dong and Seoul Forest this November, listed by date.

First to close is rom&nd's PINK OFFICE (@romand_pinkoffice), where a space dressed as a birthday party for the brand's 10th anniversary stays open through Nov 10. On Yeonmujang 5-gil, the Crayon Shin-chan exhibition has visitors walk through Shin-chan's hometown, using a dedicated app and QR codes to find and collect Hiroshi, Misae and Himawari. It runs until January next year.

The Cardcaptor Sakura collaboration café in Seoul Forest is reservation-only for every seat. It also carries merchandise sold in Japan last year, which only visitors with a reservation can buy.

지난 9월 매장 2주년에 일주일만 열었던 행사인데요, 던킨이 밝힌 당시 참가자 평균은 11개였고 이번에 정기 프로그램으로 자리를 잡았습니다. 담는 개수가 정해진 것은 아니라고 브랜드는 설명합니다.

제한 시간 안에 도넛을 종류별로 한 개씩 고르는 방식이라 같은 도넛을 여러 개 담을 수는 없고, 샌드위치·샐러드처럼 도넛이 아닌 품목은 빠집니다. 던킨 공식 계정을 태그한 버킷 사진을 인스타그램 스토리에 올려 직원에게 보여 주면 리유저블 보틀을 받을 수 있습니다.

Dunkin' Wonders Cheongdam now holds an event every Tuesday where guests have one minute to fill a bucket with doughnuts to take home.

The event first ran for a single week in September for the store's second anniversary. Dunkin' says participants took home 11 doughnuts on average then, and it is now a regular program. The brand says there is no set number of doughnuts per bucket.

Within the time limit, guests pick one doughnut of each kind, so the same doughnut can't go in twice. Items that aren't doughnuts, such as sandwiches and salads, aren't included. Post a photo of your bucket to your Instagram Story with the official Dunkin' account tagged, show it to a staff member, and you get a reusable bottle.

Schedule: Every Tuesday, 2 p.m. (numbered tickets from 1:30 p.m.)
Capacity: First 30 people
Fee: KRW 9,900
Location: Dunkin' Wonders Cheongdam, Dosan-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul

ダンキン・ワンダーズ清潭（던킨 원더스 청담）が、1分間でドーナツをバケツに詰めて持ち帰れるイベントを毎週火曜日に開きます。

もともとは今年9月、店舗の2周年に合わせて1週間だけ開かれたイベントです。ダンキンによると当時の参加者の平均は11個で、今回から定期プログラムになりました。詰める個数に決まりはないとブランドは説明しています。

制限時間内にドーナツを種類ごとに1個ずつ選ぶ方式のため、同じドーナツを複数入れることはできず、サンドイッチやサラダなどドーナツ以外の商品は対象外です。ダンキン公式アカウントをタグ付けしたバケツの写真をInstagramのストーリーに投稿してスタッフに見せると、リユーザブルボトルがもらえます。

場所：ソウル・江南区 島山大路（トサンデロ） ダンキン・ワンダーズ清潭（チョンダム）

Airbnb (@airbnb) is changing its pre-checkout cleaning rules.

Many guests have complained about paying a cleaning fee and still being asked to wash dishes and tidy up the bedding. For bookings confirmed after November 20, hosts can no longer require guests to wash or put away dishes, strip the beds, or take trash out of the property. Hosts can still make lighter requests, such as leaving used dishes in the sink or gathering used towels in one place.

All house rules must be listed on the listing page before booking, and hosts cannot add new ones through messages or notices after a reservation is made. Hosts are also barred from charging their own fines for rule violations. Airbnb says the change reflects guest feedback that the existing rules were confusing and burdensome.

Applies to: Bookings confirmed after Nov 20, 2026
Not allowed: Washing or putting away dishes, stripping beds, taking trash outside the property, host-imposed fines
Allowed: Leaving dishes in the sink, gathering used towels

Many guests have complained about paying a cleaning fee and still being asked to wash dishes and tidy up the bedding. For bookings confirmed after November 20, hosts can no longer require guests to wash or put away dishes, strip the beds, or take trash out of the property. Hosts can still make lighter requests, such as leaving used dishes in the sink or gathering used towels in one place.

All house rules must be listed on the listing page before booking, and hosts cannot add new ones through messages or notices after a reservation is made. Hosts are also barred from charging their own fines for rule violations. Airbnb says the change reflects guest feedback that the existing rules were confusing and burdensome.

Applies to: Bookings confirmed after Nov 20, 2026
Not allowed: Washing or putting away dishes, stripping beds, taking trash outside the property, host-imposed fines
Allowed: Leaving dishes in the sink, gathering used towels

Courts in Korea will be able to bar people who abuse animals from keeping animals for up to five years.

The revised Animal Protection Act was promulgated on Oct 27. The ban applies to serious abuse crimes that kill or injure animals. People punished for abuse will also be barred from adopting animals from local governments for a set period.

Some changes also reach the daily lives of people who live with animals. Owners who break care and management duties, such as using a leash shorter than 2 m or giving no shelter from heat and cold, can face an administrative fine of up to KRW 1,000,000. Leaving an animal at a pet hotel or animal hospital and never picking it up now counts as abandonment.

Promulgated: Tue, Oct 27, 2026
Effective: Thu, Oct 28, 2027
Info: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs · Korea Law Information Center

動物を虐待した人に対し、裁判所が最長5年間、動物の飼育を禁止できるようになります。

改正動物保護法が10月27日に公布されました。対象は動物を死なせたり傷つけたりする重大な虐待犯罪です。虐待犯罪で処罰された人は、一定期間、地方自治体から動物の譲渡を受けることもできません。

動物と暮らす人の日常に関わる内容もあります。2m未満のリードを使う、暑さ・寒さをしのげる休息場所を与えないなど、飼育・管理の義務に違反すると、100万ウォン以下の過料が科されることがあります。ペットホテルや動物病院に預けたまま引き取りに来ないことも、今後は遺棄とみなされます。

公布：2026年10月27日（火）
施行：2027年10月28日（木）
案内：農林畜産食品部・国家法令情報センター
